text:
```yaml
name: Check dist/

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'dist/**'

jobs:
  check-dist:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Fail if dist/ is modified
        run: |
          echo "::error::Modifications to dist/ are not allowed in pull requests."
          echo "The dist/ directory should be generated by the release workflow."
          exit 1
```
